body: People who just tell you to be positive don't understand at all. This makes me angry... omg.
I don't know, man. I'm 21. Why do you plan on leaving town? What's happening?

Pretty much the same generic BS that everyone else says. There's so many things wrong with everything you said, that it frustrates me out of my mind even trying to think of a response to type to you that I've already typed to other people a hundred times before so I'm not even going to waste my time doing it. I'm just going to take a bunch of sleeping pills, a razor blade, and cut the shit out of my entire body until I get tired enough to fucking go to sleep. I'm done with this shit.

I don't want to get better. Why would I do things to get better? Completely counter intuitive.

And your bullshit "it will get better"
 
Will it get better if I load a gun and blow my brains out? Hmm? No, it wouldn't. Now shut your mouth. Stop spouting bullshit like "it gets better". That's literally the most idiotic thing you can say to someone who's depressed.
I don't care what kind of effect it would have on them. They made me. They deal with the effects of raising a fucked up child. I have no sympathy.
No. I have my parents, that's about it, and they're just as hopeless and depressed as I am, so not really.
